instruction: The "~/pictures/" directory in my file system has photo files organized in sub-directories for each vacation spot. Compress them and save them in "~/pictures/vacations/<vacation_spot>.zip" for each vacation spot, and then delete all vacation spot sub-directories. Here, <vacation_spot> is the name of the vacation spot as it appears in the sub-directory name.

import os

# Use existing access_token/spot data from previous run if available; otherwise re-login.
try:
    access_token
    vac_dirs
    spot_names
    spot_zip_paths
except NameError:
    pw = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]['password']
    access_token = apis.file_system.login(username='adrian_burt@gmail.com', password=pw)['access_token']
    vac_dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(
        access_token=access_token,
        directory_path='~/pictures/vacations/',
        entry_type='directories',
        recursive=False
    )
    spot_names = [os.path.basename(d.rstrip('/')) for d in vac_dirs]
    spot_zip_paths = [f"~/pictures/vacations/{name}.zip" for name in spot_names]

print('vac_dirs:', vac_dirs)
print('spot_zip_paths:', spot_zip_paths)

results = []

for vac_dir, zip_path, spot in zip(vac_dirs, spot_zip_paths, spot_names):
    # Determine whether target zip already exists
    exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=access_token, file_path=zip_path).get('exists', False)
    print(f"[{spot}] zip exists? {exists} -> overwrite={exists}")

    comp_resp = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
        access_token=access_token,
        directory_path=vac_dir,
        compressed_file_path=zip_path,
        delete_directory=False,
        overwrite=bool(exists)
    )
    print(f"[{spot}] compress_resp:", comp_resp)

    # Delete only if compression succeeded and we got a compressed path back
    if 'compressed_file_path' in comp_resp:
        del_resp = apis.file_system.delete_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=vac_dir)
        print(f"[{spot}] delete_resp:", del_resp)
        results.append({'spot': spot, 'zip_path': zip_path, 'deleted': True})
    else:
        results.append({'spot': spot, 'zip_path': zip_path, 'deleted': False, 'error': comp_resp})

print('results:', results)

# Verify vacations directory now has no subdirectories
remaining_dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(
    access_token=access_token,
    directory_path='~/pictures/vacations/',
    entry_type='directories',
    recursive=False
)
print('remaining vacation spot directories:', remaining_dirs)

# Verify zip files exist
zip_existence = []
for zip_path, spot in zip(spot_zip_paths, spot_names):
    ex = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=access_token, file_path=zip_path).get('exists', False)
    zip_existence.append((spot, zip_path, ex))
print('zip existence:', zip_existence)
